E1.evidence: Reporter's reproducer (PX4 SITL in Gazebo, lidar model rotated 0.785398163 rad, mavros distance_sensor config) and log "[ERROR] [1641489853.571286350, 184.549000000]: SENSOR: wrong orientation index: 100" (https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/issues/1688); with orientation YAW_45 in the config: "DS: rangefinder_pub4: received sensor data has different orientation (100) than in config (YAW_45)!" (https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/issues/1688#issuecomment-1007988240). Maintainer confirmation: "I found bug in enum_sensor_orientation.cpp introduced by CUSTOM entry." (https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/issues/1688#issuecomment-1008431926) and on the remaining mismatch: "You have to modify simulator code to send different orientation because mavros plugin just checks if it matches config (like sanity check)." (https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/issues/1688#issuecomment-1011160733).

E2.evidence: The orientation value crosses the MAVLink boundary. PX4 SITL encodes only six mount directions and sends everything else as CUSTOM: in simulator_mavlink.cpp the switch maps PITCH_270/PITCH_90/PITCH_180/NONE/YAW_270/YAW_90 and "default:" / "dist.orientation = distance_sensor_s::ROTATION_CUSTOM;", and the DISTANCE_SENSOR stream sends "msg.orientation      = dist_sensor.orientation;" (PX4-Autopilot 07d75d85cfd0f396a1a51a83320ebee7308fc33d). mavros compares the received enum to its configured one and drops the reading on mismatch: "if (sensor->orientation >= 0 && dist_sen.orientation != sensor->orientation) {" ... "return;" (mavros_extras/src/plugins/distance_sensor.cpp at 0473145403ade6bc12d5bec9f818cbd6caeccecb). The mismatch depends on how the peer encodes a 45-degree mount (a peer that sent YAW_45 would pass), so it is not internal; the recommended change is a consumer configuration value or provider code, not a name binding or build change. The second documented failure in the same composition (mavros's array-indexed orientation table cannot look up value 100) is internal to mavros and is recorded as a condition of class other.

E3.evidence: PAIR: PX4's DISTANCE_SENSOR output feeds mavros's distance_sensor plugin input; observed during SITL: "I'm trying to use a rangefinder (distance sensor) at a 45° angle in SITL with Gazebo." (https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/issues/1688).

E4.evidence: Observed errors in both mavros builds: "[ERROR] [1641647988.732796576, 4.408000000]: DS: rangefinder_pub4: received sensor data has different orientation (100) than in config (YAW_45)!" (https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/issues/1688#issuecomment-1007988240) and after the fix "indeed I get the error message `DS: rangefinder_pub4: received sensor data has different orientation (CUSTOM) than in config (YAW_45)!`" (https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/issues/1688#issuecomment-1010921466).

failed_conditions.quote: But normally is should be recognized as YAW_45 and indeed I get the error message `DS: rangefinder_pub4: received sensor data has different orientation (CUSTOM) than in config (YAW_45)!`. Any clue to solve this ?
I found bug in enum_sensor_orientation.cpp introduced by CUSTOM entry.

loudness_evidence: mavros's distance_sensor plugin enforces its configured orientation at run time and refuses the reading with an error: "DS: rangefinder_pub4: received sensor data has different orientation (100) than in config (YAW_45)!" (https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/issues/1688#issuecomment-1007988240); the plugin code returns before publishing on this check ("return;" after the ROS_ERROR_NAMED in handle_distance_sensor). The internal lookup defect also logs "SENSOR: wrong orientation index: 100".

resolution.summary: Consumer side: take mavros master with PR #1690 (commit 58f99e13, "lib: Fix rotation search for CUSTOM", which replaces the array-indexed table with "static const std::unordered_map<typename std::underlying_type<MAV_SENSOR_ORIENTATION>::type, const OrientationPair> sensor_orientations{{" so that value 100 resolves to CUSTOM) and configure the sensor orientation as CUSTOM (or leave it unset) instead of YAW_45, relying on the TF frame for the 45-degree rotation: "Now it is likely that you can leave CUSTOM and just use tf frame which would have that rotation." Alternative from the maintainer: change the simulator to send a different orientation. PX4 unchanged.
resolution.evidence: The reporter rebuilt master and saw the lookup error disappear: "I've built master and I don't get the `SENSOR: wrong orientation index: 100` message anymore. My sensor orientation is now recognized as CUSTOM and it seems to be working." (https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/issues/1688#issuecomment-1010921466), but the configuration used for that observation is not stated, the YAW_45 configuration still failed, and the PX4 revision is known only as "latest"; the reporter's last reply is "Ok thanks !" without a further test (https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/issues/1688#issuecomment-1011186558).

notes: Units: the orientation value is first chosen by the Gazebo plugin (PX4-SITL_gazebo-classic 27298574, GazeboMavlinkInterface::setMavlinkSensorOrientation maps only PITCH_270/PITCH_90/PITCH_180/NONE/YAW_270/YAW_90 and otherwise "sensor_msg.orientation = MAV_SENSOR_ORIENTATION::MAV_SENSOR_ROTATION_CUSTOM;"), then re-mapped by PX4-Autopilot's simulator module and sent to mavros by PX4's DISTANCE_SENSOR stream; PX4-Autopilot is chosen as the provider because it is the unit mavros talks to and it applies the same six-way mapping itself, so YAW_45 is never emitted regardless of the plugin. Two documented failures in this composition: (1) the cross-boundary enum mismatch (representation_convention), which is not fixed in code; (2) mavros's internal table defect: the table was an array of 42 entries indexed by value, with the CUSTOM row at array position 41 ("/* 100 */ make_orientation("CUSTOM", ...)"), so to_string/sensor_orientation_matching rejected value 100 ("if (idx >= sensor_orientations.size()) {"), and sensor_orientation_from_str("CUSTOM") would have returned the array position rather than 100; fixed by 58f99e13 in PR #1690 (merge d6f7e9cb6dee692e0ed5549c0198889927f01dba). Commit eaaecb51 is an earlier version of the same change with the same message and parent (it references an undeclared "sensor_orientation.find(idx)"); the chengguizi/mavros commit 9185d464 is an unrelated fork sync ("Update 2021 dec (#2)") and not part of the fix. The reporter's first config without an orientation key ("distance_sensor:" / "rangefinder_pub4:" with id, frame_id, send_tf, sensor_position, field_of_view) triggered only the lookup error, because mavros skips the comparison when orientation is unset ("p->orientation = -1;	// not set"). Not observed in the source: with send_tf true, mavros derives the TF rotation from the enum table (CUSTOM maps to 0,0,0), so a 45-degree mount would be published with identity rotation. Canonical-form note: MAVLink messages are written msg:common/DISTANCE_SENSOR and field:common/DISTANCE_SENSOR.<field>, using the MAVLink dialect name (common) in place of a ROS package name. Artifact file sources: config block from https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/issues/1688#issuecomment-1007988240; code lines from mavros_extras/src/plugins/distance_sensor.cpp and mavros/src/lib/enum_sensor_orientation.cpp at 0473145403ade6bc12d5bec9f818cbd6caeccecb and d6f7e9cb6dee692e0ed5549c0198889927f01dba (https://github.com/mavlink/mavros/blob/<rev>/...). The reporter also noted YAW_90/YAW_180/YAW_270 "worked"; that statement is not analysed here.
